name: Awa Taproom
description: Awa Taproom is a calm, booking-led WordPress block theme designed for small breweries, brewpubs, and independent taprooms. Featuring a framed-window hero, custom horizontal scroll strips, and clean rule-topped cards, it pairs Fraunces serif headings with Nunito Sans body typography. Built around authentic documentary photography and an earthy umber palette, it presents tap lists, table reservations, and brewhouse stories with quiet craftsmanship.
